searchText: Hi everyone, Louis from StarkWare. I'll send some projects we are interested in for StarkNet and would love your feedbacks. I'm not sure of the program duration and scope. Can someone give me a rough estimate of expected time to complete projects? For me to calibrate my submissions the program runs for four months, some people start right away working on a topic, others take some extra time Great. I'll submit a set of proposals then 🙂 <@!619138323776012307> there's a github tracker where you can post project details, too. See: https://github.com/ethereum-cdap/cohort-one/issues
